acceptance_criteria: The imported Stage 3 ledger, contract, preflight, independent review, and approval packet match their sealed hashes before execution.
The founder approval receipt exactly binds fingerprint 02ae44fd8fc26a4defc16e8924fcd3b40f60dbe04b5e8ad221b688ed568d4a0f, one candidate, four credits, and no automatic retry.
Only the approval-receipt binding may change the contract after the approved fingerprint was calculated.
The immutable paid-attempt marker is consumed before the sole POST /v1/run submission.
Exactly one Try-On Max request uses the sealed product image, model image, prompt, 2k quality mode, seed 42, one PNG, and base64 transport.
The provider receipt records job ID, exact source hashes, request, output hash and geometry, provider-reported credits, and authenticated balance change.
The candidate remains quarantined and candidate-only with no scene-input, promotion, wiring, publication, or deployment authority.
No retry occurs for failure, rejection, timeout, or ambiguous submission outcome.
Stage 5 independent review is not started automatically.
